nvitk.db.catalog¶

Dataset catalog: repository.json, table manifests, variable registry, scaffold helpers.

DatasetCatalog is the source of truth for paths and schemas under the dataset root.

Classes¶

TableDefinition

Static description of one Parquet-backed table (columns, keys, wide pivot settings).

DatasetCatalog

Load and update catalog/repository.json, resolve table paths, variables, and pipelines.

class nvitk.db.catalog.DatasetCatalog(root: str | pathlib.Path)¶

Load and update catalog/repository.json, resolve table paths, variables, and pipelines.

Use get_table() for TableDefinition rows and list_tables() for names.

classmethod create_scaffold(root: str | pathlib.Path) → pathlib.Path¶

Create a minimal dataset tree at root by copying the packaged catalog templates (manifests + schema) and creating empty tables//cache/ directories.

refresh() → None¶

Re-read all manifest JSON files from disk and rebuild the in-memory TableDefinition cache. Called after every catalog mutation to keep this instance consistent with disk.

property sqlite_index_path: pathlib.Path¶

Absolute path to the SQLite query-cache database declared in the repository manifest.

property table_root: pathlib.Path¶

Absolute path to the directory holding this dataset’s Parquet table files.

list_tables() → list[str]¶

Sorted names of every table registered in the manifest.

get_table(name: str) → TableDefinition¶

Return name’s TableDefinition, raising TableNotFoundError if unregistered.

table_exists(name: str) → bool¶

True if name is a registered table.

ensure_table_definition(name: str, *, clone_from: str) → pathlib.Path¶

Register name in tables.json by cloning manifest metadata from clone_from, pointing at <table_root>/{name}.parquet. Creates an empty Parquet file if missing.

No-op (returns existing Parquet path) when name is already registered.

ensure_cognitive_measurements_table() → pathlib.Path¶

Register cognitive_measurements with the canonical long-form schema.

list_pipelines(modality: str | None = None) → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

All pipeline entries, or just those matching modality (case-insensitive) if given.

default_pipeline_id(modality: str) → str | None¶

The pipeline_id flagged is_default for modality, or None if none is set.

pipeline_ids_for_role(role: str) → list[str]¶

pipeline_id values for every pipeline entry tagged with role.

all_pipeline_ids() → set[str]¶

Set of every registered pipeline_id across all modalities.

_pipeline_entries_for_modality(modality: str | None) → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

Pipeline entries for modality (case-insensitive), or all entries if modality is unset.

static _normalize_pipeline_tokens(selector: str | int | Iterable[str | int] | None) → list[str]¶

Coerce a pipeline selector (a single str/int or an iterable of them) into a flat list of non-empty stripped string tokens.

resolve_pipeline_selector(selector: str | int | Iterable[str | int] | None, *, modality: str | None = None) → list[str] | None¶

Return None to apply catalog defaults per modality in DataRepo.image. Otherwise return an explicit pipeline_id list.

Aliases from measurement_pipelines.json (including integers like 1 / 2) resolve within the pipelines for modality when provided; without modality, ambiguous aliases raise ManifestError.

validate_pipelines_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Validate the pipelines manifest structure and reject duplicate is_default pipelines within the same modality; raises ManifestError on any violation.

variable_entries(*, domain: str | None = None, table: str | None = None) → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

Registered variable entries, optionally filtered by domain and/or table.

resolve_variable_ids(requested: str | Iterable[str] | None, *, domain: str | None = None) → list[str]¶

Resolve requested names/aliases/source-column names/labels to canonical variable_id values (case- and normalization-insensitive), leaving any unmatched entries unchanged.

register_variables(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], *, merge: bool = True) → None¶

Add or update entries in the variables manifest (merging into existing entries with the same variable_id when merge is True, otherwise overwriting), then persist and reload.

_merge_variable_entry(existing: dict[str, Any], new: dict[str, Any]) → dict[str, Any]¶

Merge new onto existing: union+de-dupe aliases, and for every other key skip empty strings/lists/None in new so a partial update never blanks out existing metadata.

update_table_schema(name: str, df: pandas.DataFrame, *, provenance: dict[str, Any] | None = None, path: str | None = None) → None¶

Update (or create) name’s entry in the tables manifest from df’s inferred dtypes, row count, and optional provenance/path, then persist and reload.

clear_table(name: str) → None¶

Delete the Parquet file for name if present and set row_count to 0 in the manifest.

validate_repository_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload is missing any REQUIRED_REPOSITORY_KEYS.

validate_tables_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload’s tables object or any entry is malformed.

validate_variables_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload lacks a variables list, or if any entry is invalid.

_validate_variable_entry(entry: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError/ValidationError if entry is missing required keys or has a blank variable_id.
